sloka: कस्त्वम् केन च कार्येण इह प्राप्तो वनालय ।कथय स्वेह यत्तत्त्वम् यावत्प्राणा धरन्ति ते ॥५-३-२३॥
transliteration: kastvam kena ca kāryeṇa iha prāpto vanālaya ।kathaya sveha yattattvam yāvatprāṇā dharanti te ॥5-3-23॥

translations.english: "O dweller of the forest, who are you? Why did you come here? Speak the truth about your identity, so long as you hold on to your life.
translations.hindi: झरे वनवासी बंदर ! तू कोन है ? और यहाँ क्यों आया है ? यदि तुझे अपने प्राण प्यारे हों तो ठीक ठीक बतला
